Is the Audi A6 Allroad the BEST Audi on sale?
The all-new Audi A6 Allroad is here!
It’s the fifth iteration of the A6 Allroad, and Mat’s about to put this one through its paces to see if it has what it takes to stack up against its predecessors. What’s more, he’ll also see how the practicality compares to some of the latest Audi estates and SUVs available today.
But first up, let’s check out the design…
